cohort: 242,342 newborns, 771 born to HBV/HCV mothers and 241,571 born to non-carriers,  born between 1991-2014.
finding: Maternal HBV or HCV carrier status is an independent risk factor for long-term gastrointestinal morbidity in offspring.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as a confounder in the analysis but the study did not report on specific findings related to mode of delivery.
